## Evidence

test_estimate_view_header_sitting passed. The non-tmux suite passed (604). The tmux suite failed: 3 failed, 12 passed. The side pane showed `title of fx… · subagent` instead of `title of fx-running` and `title of fx-ready`. The waiting row missed `title of fx-waiting waits on fx-running` and rendered as `● ·`.

## Missing

none

## Reason

The sitting phrase is on the header. The suite failed because the executor suffix is wider than the tmux title cell: the cell keeps the full suffix past the column, so the terminal cuts the title and the waits-on note.
